usage.outputShape: body.image_url (persistent CDN-hosted JPG on DigitalOcean Spaces); also body.image_description, body.metadata.model, body.metadata.grok_url (temporary xAI source URL), body.metadata.cdn_key
quirks: payment.accepts is Solana (USDC on Solana), not Base, despite the registry priceDisplay being chain-agnostic
body.metadata.grok_url is a temporary xAI URL that expires; use body.image_url for anything durable
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://api.xona-agent.com/image/grok-imagine with JSON body {"prompt": "<your text>"} and pay the x402 charge (~$0.04 USDC, settled on Solana). The response is synchronous JSON: read the generated image from body.image_url, which is a persistent CDN-hosted JPG. Avoid body.metadata.grok_url for anything you need to keep — it is a temporary xAI source URL.
